Strengths:

  • Played in a pro style offense comfortably. Makes his reads and goes through progressions. Good at throwing with touch, timing, and anticipation.

  • Very good accuracy at all levels, particularly underneath. Deep accuracy is inconsistent but still generally solid. Smart decision maker. Rarely turns the ball over.

  • Always looks calm and collected. Doesn’t get flustered into forcing passes and making bad throws.

Weaknesses:

  • Mechanics. Footwork still in progress and needs work. Elongated throwing motion could use refinement. Stands too wide at times. Limited arm strength. Sometimes throws with decent zip but too many floated balls.

  • Less than ideal size and for the position. Not very mobile, strictly a pocket passer.

  • Can sometimes hold the ball too long, especially for someone with his limited escapability.

  • Too passive at times. Generally doesn’t throw into tight windows downfield, perhaps because of the limited arm strength.

Overall: Kessler has a lot of qualities you desire in a quarterback, but his lack of arm strength is noticeable right off the bat. He can make the majority of NFL throws, but I question his ability to thread the needle downfield as well as hit some routes to the outside that need that extra drive. Besides that, he needs some major mechanical overhaul and wouldn’t be ready to go from day one. Improved mechanics may help his arm strength, but that isn’t a risk I would take before early round 3.
